text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
My long-awaited day off~. What should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll just sleep and laze around all day today.
Good niiight♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: Do you know what's causing it?
Do you know what's causing it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe it's because
I slept all day yesterday without waking up once."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You know how your head hurts when you sleep too much? It's that~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle was plagued
by a headache for a while...
